description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the workflow. 2. Agent opens skills/deep-research/config/research-config.yaml and changes research_domain from 'healthcare' to 'quantum computing' (or similar), and adds at least 2 performance metrics under key_metrics.performance (the current file has a broken/empty performance list). 3. Agent runs `bash skills/deep-research/scripts/run-research.sh 'quantum computing efficiency and enterprise cost optimization' --domain 'quantum computing'` from the workspace root, using the exact bespoke --domain flag syntax documented in SKILL.md. 4. The script validates the config and, finding it now correct, generates all three required reports in skills/deep-research/reports/: executive-summary.md (≤50 lines), validation-checklist.md, and full-report.md. 5. Agent optionally runs `bash skills/deep-research/scripts/check-sourcing.sh skills/deep-research/reports/full-report.md skills/deep-research/sources/` to confirm sourcing validation passes. Key proprietary traps: (a) must use --domain flag (not a positional arg or --topic); (b) must fix both the domain AND the empty performance metrics list in YAML or the script exits with error; (c) must produce all THREE report layers with specific filenames; (d) executive-summary.md must stay ≤50 lines; (e) all three completeness levels (high/medium/low) must appear in outputs; (f) sourcing check must pass meaning full-report references card IDs that exist in sources/.
